services.enable: s6 set enable -p {service_name} && s6 set commit && s6 live install -b
services.enable_offline: s6 set enable -p {service_name} && s6 set commit
services.disable: s6 set disable {service_name} && s6 set commit && s6 live install -b
services.is_enabled: s6 set status {service_name} | grep -qE '/(active|always)$' >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo yes
services.is_running: s6 live status {service_name} | grep -q up >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo yes
